sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the first interpretation of "Yashresh Yaakov" as referring to the future redemption, where the root of the soul will be revealed.

translations.translation: “The coming ones shall take root (Yashresh) Yaakov etc.”¹,
and the Tzemach Tzedek brings in his maamar beginning with this phrase²
the interpretation of the Targum Yonasan on the verse, that this refers to the redemption.
For the translation of “the coming ones” (haba’im) is “they will be gathered from among their exiles and will return to their land”
[for “the coming ones” refers to the coming to the land that will be in the future redemption,
“and He will bring you”³
“Hashem your G-d to the land”⁴],
and then “Yashresh Yaakov” will be,
“there the house of Yaakov will be born.”
And he explains in the maamar,
that “taking root”
(Yashresh)
is concealment
(like the rooting of a tree,
for the roots of the tree that are in the ground are in concealment)
and “birth” is revelation
(for before birth, while it is in its mother’s womb,
it is in concealment,
and when it is born it comes into revelation),
and this is that the translation of “Yashresh” is “they will be born” (yisyalidon),
meaning,
that the root of the soul
(Yashresh Yaakov)
will be in revelation
(they will be born).

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the second interpretation of "Yashresh Yaakov" as referring to the fulfillment of mitzvos, which draws down the root of the soul from above the chain of descent.

translations.translation: And he continues in the maamar⁵
with another interpretation of “Yashresh Yaakov,”
that this refers to the fulfillment of the mitzvos.
For just as rooting in its simple sense is specifically in the ground,
so too with the soul
(Yaakov),
the rooting is in the fulfillment of practical mitzvos.
And the connection between the two interpretations of “Yashresh Yaakov”⁶
(the revelation of the root of the soul and the fulfillment of mitzvos)
is,
that the revelation of the root of the soul that will be in the future is through the fulfillment of mitzvos now.
And the concept is⁷,
that in the root of the soul there are several levels.
And the primary root of the soul is as it is rooted in the light that is above the chain of descent (hishtalshelus),
and this light is drawn down through the fulfillment of mitzvos.
For the drawing down through the study of Torah is from the aspect of Chochmah,
the beginning of the chain of descent,
and the drawing down of the light that is above the chain of descent
is through the deed of mitzvos⁸.
And this is what our sages, of blessed memory, said⁹
“Whoever’s deeds are greater than his wisdom etc. is like a tree whose branches are few and whose roots are many,”
for the drawing down of the root of the soul is through the deed of mitzvos.
And this is the connection of the two interpretations of “Yashresh Yaakov,”
that through the fulfillment of mitzvos now
(the second interpretation of “Yashresh Yaakov”)
the root of the soul is drawn down,
and the revelation of this drawing down will be in the future,
“there the house of Yaakov will be born” (yisyalidon),
that the root of the soul will shine in revelation
(the first interpretation of “Yashresh Yaakov”).
